review: 1:3 צוּר עוֹלָמִים קֶדֶם — 'Rock of ages from of old', for صَخْرَ الدُّهُورِ الْأَزَلِيّ; קֶדֶם is the biblical 'of old' and keeps the line at seven.
3:1 בְּבִדְלוּתִי בְּשִׁמְמָתִי — 'in my solitude, in my desolation'; שִׁמְמָה is the biblical waste/desolation (Lev 26:34), used here for وَحْشَة.
5:1 אֵין תּוֹחֶלֶת בִּי — 'there is no hope in me', for لَا نَفْعَ يُرْجَى; the passive 'is hoped' has no natural Hebrew equivalent, so the sense is carried by תּוֹחֶלֶת.
6:3 יוֹם נָסְעִי — 'the day of my setting out', for الرَّحِيل; נָסַע is the biblical verb for breaking camp, which keeps the pilgrimage image.
6:4 אֶעְלֶה לְמוֹלַדְתִּי — 'I shall go up to my homeland'; the glossary fixes מוֹלַדְתִּי for وَطَن, and the ascent fits 'in the Father's house on high' (hymn 29).
